topic.remark: ssarkar: This glue is shared by the "Virtualization on SUSE Linux", "Managing Virtualization Platforms with libvirt", and "Managing KVM Virtualization" articles. The new virt-v2v item links to the local anchor "#virt-v2v-vmware-migration", but that section is only included as a module in the "Virtualization on SUSE Linux" article (where the link is redundant with content the reader is already on) and not in the other two (where the anchor won't resolve). Should this link point to a real published URL like the other items, or be removed from this shared glue?
